system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Open-source dataset of grid-scale (1 MW and greater) electricity generating facilities operating across the world.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Maintained reference dataset with periodic updates; represents current operational power plants globally.
data_description.spatial_resolution: Point locations of power plants with exact coordinates
data_description.temporal_unit: Maintained reference - represents current operational status
data_description.records: Global coverage of grid-scale electricity generating facilities with attributes including capacity, fuel type, ownership, and commissioning year
data_description.data_type_numeric: Power plant capacity in megawatts (MW); inspect properties for fuel type, primary fuel, capacity factor, and generation estimates.

vector_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

data_description.important_note: This dataset provides comprehensive information on electricity generation infrastructure worldwide. Each feature represents an individual power plant with detailed attributes including fuel type (coal, natural gas, solar, wind, hydro, nuclear, etc.), installed capacity, ownership, and operational status. The database is valuable for energy infrastructure analysis, carbon emissions estimation, and renewable energy transition studies.
analytical_capabilities: Global energy infrastructure mapping and spatial distribution analysis
Fuel mix analysis by region and country
Renewable vs. fossil fuel capacity assessment
Power generation density and accessibility analysis
Carbon emissions estimation from electricity generation
Infrastructure planning and grid expansion studies

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Check feature properties for fuel_type, primary_fuel, capacity_mw, commissioning_year, owner, and estimated_generation_gwh fields.

data_description.data_source: World Resources Institute via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
